plain_text:
K-opioid receptor agonist tripsitting is defined as the techniques which directly alter k-opioid receptor agonist cognition in a manner that improves the functionality or perceived functionality of the user.

This page lists and describes the various k-opioid receptor agonist tripsitting techniques.
